headline: Chest-high peaks with an offshore-leaning morning — a fun one.
today: Good SE angle to 2.2ft with a bit of long-period in the mix, and after a 10mph cross-on dawn the wind swings WSW cross-off for the rest of the day. That afternoon offshore is a nice bonus if the swell holds. Groveler or log in the morning, shortboard if the sets show. One of the better spots today if you don't want the full Montauk drive.

daysToWatch.note: Prime ESE angle to 2.1ft with a 3mph light-wind glassy morning — small but clean, dawn is the move.
Builds to 2.9ft on a good ESE angle with light cross dawn winds — best size-plus-wind combo of the week here, surf early before it goes cross-on.
